en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front side features an illustrated panoramic view of an exhibition area by the water, with ships, a large greenhouse-like building, domes, and a minaret-shaped tower with the Swedish flag. Crowds and horse-drawn carriages are visible. There is handwritten text overlaying the artwork, along with printed text at the bottom identifying it as an official postcard for 'Stockholms-Utställningen 1897' (the Stockholm Exhibition of 1897). The reverse side contains a green ornate border, printed and handwritten Swedish text, a red stamp with a postmark dated 1897, and is addressed to a recipient in Skara.
